# `commands`

::: info
Анықтаманың өзі ағылшын тілінде: ол WIT файлдарынан автоматты түрде жасалады.
:::

Chat and console commands registered by mods. A registered command is routed to its mod for every allowed sender, before the built-in commands. Vanilla only treats `/` lines from moderators and admins as commands; mod commands work for any player unless `min-role` says otherwise.

Package `blockheads:api@0.2.0` · Lua table `bh.commands` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/commands.wit)

Uses: `types.{api-error}`, `players.{role}`, `events.{command-sender}`

## Types

### `command-id` <Badge type="info" text="type" />

```txt
type command-id = u32;
```

Identifies one registered command of the calling mod.

### `command-spec` <Badge type="info" text="record" />

Describes a command.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name without `/`: `[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}`. Must not collide with built-in or other mods' commands. |
| `aliases` | `list<string>` | Extra names, same rules as `name`. |
| `description` | `string` | One line of help text. |
| `usage` | `string` | Usage text shown when the handler returns `handled = false`, for example `/home [name]`. |
| `min-role` | `role` | The lowest role allowed to run it from chat. |
| `console` | `bool` | Whether the console may run it. |

### `command-outcome` <Badge type="info" text="record" />

What a command handler returns.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `handled` | `bool` | False shows the usage text to the sender. |
| `reply` | `list<string>` | Lines sent back to the sender (chat for players, log for the console). |

## Functions

### `register` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
register: func(spec: command-spec) -> result<command-id, api-error>;
```

Registers a command; the host calls `guest.run-command` when it is used.

### `unregister` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
unregister: func(id: command-id) -> bool;
```

Removes a command. Returns false if it did not exist.
